question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
top_drivers AS (
  SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) as rn
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
top_constructors AS (
  SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) as rn
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT td.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name,
       td.points as driver_points,
       c.name as constructor_name,
       tc.points as constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
JOIN drivers d ON td.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON tc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE td.rn = 1 AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY td.year
